definitions.short: a separation , i.e. (concretely) a separate place
definitions.full: H3995. mibdalah [ מִבְדָּלָה ] noun feminine separate place , הַמִּבְדָּלוֺת Josh 16:9 (appositive הֶעָרִים ); but read probably הַמֻּבְדָּלוֺת Hoph`al Participle from בדל , or הַנִּבְדָּלוֺת Niph`al Participle , compare Di.
